pictures.name: Modern city
pictures.scene: A modern city plaza: glass towers and office buildings, a fountain, trimmed trees and flower planters, street lamps, and no people.

pictures.name: Meadow route
pictures.ground: short meadow grass and a sandy dirt path
pictures.scene: A gentle country route: soft rolling meadow, patches of tall grass, low grassy ledges, small round trees, a winding dirt path, a wooden signpost, and a small town's rooftops far away on the horizon.

pictures.name: Deep cavern
pictures.scene: A vast dark cavern lit by a single soft glow: jagged rock, stalagmites, stone ramps between levels, heavy round boulders, and a thin waterfall in the back.

pictures.name: Flower route
pictures.scene: A bright route through flower fields: tall grass full of small white, yellow and pink flowers, low wooden fences, a little gatehouse, a pond with lily pads, and hazy blue hills far away.

pictures.name: Rocky hills
pictures.scene: A hilly route in rocky grassland: boulders and stony ledges between grass patches, a few wind-bent trees, and a rounded grey mountain on the horizon.

pictures.name: Cave
pictures.ground: smooth grey cave floor with scattered pebbles
pictures.scene: A wide cave: rock walls with ledges and wooden ladders, round boulders, a still pool, glittering specks in the stone, and a beam of daylight from a crack above.

pictures.name: Harbour town
pictures.ground: harbour planks and a stone quay
pictures.scene: A port town: wooden docks and a stone quay, moored boats and a ferry, stacked crates, a tall white lighthouse on the cape, and the open sea beyond.

pictures.name: Country town
pictures.scene: A small country town: a few houses with colourful roofs and flower boxes, a fountain square, a big shady tree, and fields beyond.

pictures.name: Pokémon League
pictures.ground: grand stone plaza with wide steps
pictures.scene: A grand league building on a high plateau: wide stone stairs, columns, tall flagpoles with banners, and a sea of clouds and blue mountains below.

pictures.name: Sandy beach
pictures.scene: A sunny beach: white sand, turquoise shallows, a few palms and striped umbrellas, shells and driftwood, and a small island on the horizon.

pictures.name: Marsh
pictures.scene: A marsh in soft rain: shallow pools and mud, tall reeds and cattails, wooden boardwalks on stilts, mossy rocks and drooping trees.

pictures.name: Snowfield
pictures.scene: A snowy route: deep drifts, frozen pine trees heavy with snow, ice-glazed rocks, a few falling snowflakes, and white peaks behind.

pictures.name: Crystal cavern
pictures.scene: A cavern of glowing crystals: clusters in cyan, lilac and pink growing from the walls, still water reflecting them, ancient carvings, and smooth stone floors.

pictures.name: Haunted grounds
pictures.scene: A haunted memorial ground at dusk: rows of small rounded gravestones, drifting purple fog, flickering candles, bare trees, and a tall tower against a violet sky.

pictures.name: Champion's hall
pictures.ground: polished stone floor with a red carpet
pictures.scene: The champion's hall: a grand chamber with a red carpet, tall columns, two dragon statues, torches and high windows letting in golden light.

pictures.name: Woodland
pictures.ground: mossy forest floor with a trodden path
pictures.scene: A sun-dappled woodland: tall trunks under a thick canopy, shafts of morning light, tall grass and ferns between the trees, fallen logs, and a narrow path weaving through.

pictures.name: Lakeshore
pictures.scene: A wide calm lake ringed by trees and tall grass: a small island in the middle, reeds, a wooden jetty, and blue mountains reflected in the water.

pictures.name: Volcano
pictures.scene: A volcano's slopes: dark rock, ash-grey ground, lava glowing in cracks, steam vents and hot springs, and a smoking crater on the horizon.

pictures.name: Industrial interior
pictures.scene: A dim industrial interior: humming machines and generators, pipes and cables, metal walkways, warning lights, computer consoles and crates.

pictures.name: Farmland
pictures.ground: pasture grass and a dirt track
pictures.scene: Rolling farmland: a red-roofed barn, white wooden fences, grazing pasture, round haystacks, a windmill, and a country lane winding away between dry-stone walls.

pictures.name: Old dark forest
pictures.scene: A deep, old forest where daylight barely reaches: huge dark trunks, twisted roots, big pale mushrooms, ferns, a small wooden shrine, and mist between the trees.

pictures.name: Badlands canyon
pictures.scene: A dry canyon of eroded red-brown rock: mesas and natural arches, cracked earth, dry scrub, and dust blowing between the cliffs.

pictures.name: Mountain pass
pictures.scene: A high mountain pass: steep blue-grey slopes, stony ledges and boulders, a dark cave mouth in the cliff, and a trail winding up into thin cloud.

pictures.name: Evening road
pictures.ground: grass verges beside a paved road
pictures.scene: A wide road between towns at golden hour: low hedges and tall grass, a small gatehouse, a line of trees and distant rooftops catching the low sun.

pictures.name: Open sea
pictures.ground: a pale sandbar with shallow lapping water
pictures.scene: Open sea between islands: calm turquoise water to the horizon, gentle swells and sparkles, small rocky islets, and a sandbar with a single palm in front.

pictures.name: Desert
pictures.scene: A desert in a sandstorm haze: sweeping dunes, sun-bleached rocks and cacti, and the shimmer of ancient ruins half buried in sand far away.

pictures.name: Mine
pictures.scene: A working mine: mine carts on rails, wooden supports, dark coal seams in the walls, hanging lanterns, a conveyor belt and heaps of rubble.

pictures.name: Old town
pictures.scene: A traditional old town: wooden houses with tiled roofs, a slender pagoda, stone lanterns, blossoming and maple trees, and a small canal with a stone bridge.

pictures.name: Battle facilities
pictures.scene: A plaza of battle facilities in golden light: a tower, a dome and a castle-like hall around a fountain, flags, and palm trees.

pictures.name: Tropical route
pictures.ground: tropical grass and a sandy road
pictures.scene: A tropical island road: palm trees, red hibiscus bushes, tall grass, a low stone wall, a thatched hut, and a bright sea glittering beyond.

pictures.name: Snowy town
pictures.scene: A snowy northern town: stone and wooden houses with steep snow-covered roofs and warm lit windows, a steaming hot spring, lamp posts, and snowy peaks behind.

pictures.name: Ice cave
pictures.scene: A frozen cave: blue-white ice walls, slippery ice floors, icicles hanging from the ceiling, frozen boulders and cold mist.

pictures.name: Tropical jungle
pictures.scene: A tropical rainforest: huge leaves, bright flowers, hanging vines, palm trunks, a stream with a small waterfall, dense undergrowth and dappled green light.

pictures.name: Ancient ruins chamber
pictures.scene: An ancient sealed chamber: stone walls covered in carved glyphs and dot patterns (abstract, no letters), square pillars, sliding stone tiles, drifts of sand, and a single ray of light falling on a stone dais.

pictures.name: Summit above the clouds
pictures.scene: The ruined summit of an ancient tower above the clouds: a cracked stone platform, broken pillars in a circle, a sea of cloud below, and a swirling dawn sky with flashes of light.

pictures.name: Heart of the volcano
pictures.scene: The heart of a volcano: rivers of glowing magma, cracked basalt columns, an altar-like ledge of dark rock, steam and shimmering heat haze.

pictures.name: Crystal depths
pictures.scene: A vast cavern of giant glowing crystals: prismatic terraces, pink, white and teal gems, a shimmering pool, and light refracting everywhere.

pictures.name: Secret island
pictures.ground: white sand and very tall grass
pictures.scene: A tiny secret tropical island: very tall grass, a single lush tree in a clearing, a quiet stone monument, a ring of white sand, turquoise water and a soft pink morning haze.

pictures.name: Deep sea cavern
pictures.ground: wet rock beside deep blue water
pictures.scene: A deep sea cavern: a dark primordial pool glowing blue, a waterfall inside the cave, swirling currents, wet carved ledges and dripping water.

pictures.name: Frozen sanctum
pictures.scene: A frozen ancient sanctum: ice-glazed stone pillars, a frozen floor, frost-covered carvings, cold mist, and a colossal sealed door.

pictures.name: Hidden laboratory
pictures.scene: A hidden research laboratory: white and steel corridors, broken consoles and glass tanks, cables across the floor, warning stripes, and a strange machine glowing teal.

pictures.name: Forest shrine
pictures.ground: soft moss and roots in a sunny glade
pictures.scene: A small wooden shrine in a sunny glade of an ancient forest: mossy roots, ferns, white flowers, a little pond, and soft green motes of light.

pictures.name: Power Plant
pictures.ground: dusty metal plating with loose cables
pictures.scene: An abandoned power plant: a dusty industrial hall with big generators, copper coils and pipes, flickering yellow lights, sparks, and thick cables snaking across the floor.

pictures.name: Cerulean Cave
pictures.scene: A mysterious water-filled cave: still dark pools, glowing blue-violet crystals, a raised rocky island in the centre, eerie mist, and the feeling that something powerful sleeps here.

pictures.name: Mt. Silver
pictures.scene: The summit of the highest mountain in the land: a snow-swept peak, deep drifts, jagged dark rocks, swirling snow, a flat clearing at the very top, and clouds far below lit by a pale sun.

pictures.name: Bell Tower
pictures.scene: A tall golden nine-storey pagoda rising above autumn maples, bronze bells hanging from its curled eaves, a stone path and torii-like gate in front, and faint rainbow light streaking the sky.

pictures.name: Birth Island
pictures.scene: A tiny island under a starry sky: a black triangular stone floating above the ground, glittering sand, a ring of strange rocks, and a faint aurora.

pictures.name: The Old Chateau
pictures.scene: A dusty abandoned mansion: a long dining hall with a cobwebbed table, old portraits, a broken chandelier, tall windows, and an old TV flickering in the corner.

pictures.name: The Lakes of Sinnoh
pictures.ground: smooth stone at a still pool
pictures.scene: A sacred cave under a lake: a small island cave with a still, glowing pool, smooth stone, ripples of light on the walls, and three soft points of light.

pictures.name: Turnback Cave
pictures.scene: A misty labyrinth room: square stone pillars, deep fog, faint footprints, and a swirling distortion portal in the back wall.

pictures.name: Fullmoon Island
pictures.scene: A crescent-shaped island forest under a full moon: silver-lit trees, a quiet clearing, glittering motes like feathers, and a calm sea.

pictures.name: Newmoon Island
pictures.scene: A dark forest island under a moonless sky: black trees with twisted roots, bluish shadows, a ring-shaped clearing, and a faint, uneasy mist.

pictures.name: The Seabreak Path
pictures.ground: pale sand shoals in shallow water
pictures.scene: A path of pale sand shoals leading across a gentle sea toward the horizon, ocean all around, clear shallow water and a warm sunrise.

pictures.name: Flower Paradise
pictures.ground: a carpet of small pink flowers
pictures.scene: A hidden field carpeted with small pink and white flowers, glowing pollen drifting in the air, a clear lake, and mountains around.

pictures.name: The Hall of Origin
pictures.scene: A cosmic hall at the top of a stairway of light: a white-gold floor, glowing pillars, and a starry rainbow sky.

pictures.name: Black City & White Forest
pictures.scene: Two halves of one place: dark skyscrapers on one side and a lush white forest on the other.

pictures.name: Liberty Garden
pictures.scene: A small island garden: a lighthouse, trimmed hedges, flower beds, and a calm sea around it.

pictures.name: The Castelia Café
pictures.scene: A cosy street café in a city of skyscrapers: tables and parasols on a terrace, potted plants, and a little stage.

pictures.name: The Swords of Justice
pictures.scene: A hidden mountain cave: moss on the walls, a sunbeam through a crack, three flat stones in a triangle, and a quiet pool.

pictures.name: The Moor of Icirrus Spring
pictures.ground: lush spring grass by clear pools
pictures.scene: A moor in spring: lush green grass, clear pools reflecting a blue sky, and small white flowers.

pictures.name: The Team Flare Secret HQ Depths
pictures.scene: The chamber of an ultimate weapon deep underground: a giant flower-like machine, dark red glow, and pipes.

pictures.name: Terminus Cave
pictures.scene: An old abandoned mine: overturned carts on rusty rails, rubble heaps, sagging wooden supports, lanterns, and tunnels leading deep into the dark.

pictures.name: Hoopa's Ring
pictures.scene: A golden ring portal floating above a sandy oasis with palms, under a warped sky.

pictures.name: The Altar of the Sunne and Moone
pictures.scene: A stone altar on a mountain summit beside a still lake that mirrors the sky, sun and moon emblems carved into its floor, under a cosmic dusk sky.

pictures.name: Ultra Megalopolis
pictures.scene: A dark city of glowing towers whose light has been stolen, with one giant tower at the centre.

pictures.name: The Ruins of the Guardians
pictures.scene: Ancient stone temples on tropical islands: carved guardian masks over the doorways, mossy steps, vines, ferns, and a bright sky.

pictures.name: Ultra Space
pictures.scene: An alien dimension beyond a glowing wormhole: floating broken rocks, luminous jelly-like shapes, pale crystal sand and strange thin towers under a shifting violet sky.

pictures.name: Poni Grove
pictures.scene: A dense tropical forest grove: mossy stone paths, giant ferns, ancient trees with buttress roots, and sunlight breaking through the leaves.

pictures.name: Magearna's Workshop
pictures.scene: A centuries-old workshop: gears and cogs on the walls, brass instruments, wooden workbenches covered in tools, and warm lamplight.

pictures.name: Ten Carat Hill's Farthest Hollow
pictures.scene: The deepest hollow of a crystal cave: dark stone, long shadows, a few dim crystals, and a single eerie glow in the centre.

pictures.name: The Blush Mountain Storm
pictures.scene: A mountain in a thunderstorm: lightning cracking across dark clouds, slanting rain, wet rocky slopes, and a power plant's lights in the distance.

pictures.name: The Mystery Box
pictures.scene: A mysterious metallic box with nuts and bolts in a steel room, and a soft silver light.

pictures.name: The Max Lair
pictures.scene: Underground caverns full of red glowing energy crystals: tunnels branching off, cracked rock, and a red haze.

pictures.name: The Space-Time Rift
pictures.scene: A glowing rift in the sky over an old-world meadow: purple distortion, floating rocks, and wild flowers.

pictures.name: The Energy Plant Summit
pictures.scene: A rooftop battle pitch on a skyscraper at night: a vast red energy vortex swirling overhead, city lights below.

pictures.name: The Slumbering Weald's Depths
pictures.scene: A misty enchanted forest, ancient ruins, and stone statues of a sword and a shield.

pictures.name: The Master Dojo
pictures.scene: A traditional dojo: wooden floors, sliding paper doors, training mats, and a tropical garden outside.

pictures.name: The Crown Shrine
pictures.scene: A snowy shrine on a mountain: stone steps, a weathered wooden shrine, and a giant tree shaped like a crown.

pictures.name: The Forest of Focus
pictures.scene: A lush tropical jungle: a winding river, small waterfalls, giant leaves, vines, and dappled green light.

pictures.name: The Crimson Mirelands
pictures.scene: A red-tinted marsh: misty bogs, gnarled ancient trees, red-brown mud flats, and pools reflecting a grey sky.

pictures.name: Dyna Tree Hill
pictures.scene: A hill crowned by a giant ancient tree glowing with energy, snow and red berries on its branches.

pictures.name: Area Zero
pictures.scene: The depths of a great crater: tiers of grassy cliffs and waterfalls, huge glowing crystals, and research stations.

pictures.name: The Land of Kitakami
pictures.scene: A Japanese countryside: rice fields, an old village of wooden houses, a mountain, and apple orchards.

pictures.name: Blueberry Academy & the Terarium
pictures.scene: A modern school campus floating off the coast, beside a giant glass dome holding savanna, coast, canyon and polar biomes side by side.

pictures.name: The Shrines of Ruin
pictures.scene: Four small ancient shrines sealed with wooden stakes, deep in the wild, in gloomy mist and twisted trees.

pictures.name: Loyalty Plaza
pictures.scene: A stone plaza with three weathered stone guardian statues, autumn trees, festival lanterns, and a shrine gate.

pictures.name: Oni Mountain & the Crystal Pool
pictures.scene: A craggy peak above a Japanese countryside, and a hidden cave with a clear pool and glittering crystals.

pictures.name: Kitakami Hall
pictures.scene: A traditional wooden hall decorated for a festival at night: paper lanterns and food stalls.
